config.manifest.routing_enabled_help: Sends extra headers with requests to Manifest so Manifest can pick the matching model according to your tiers.
config.manifest.routing_specificity_mode: Off sends no category, Fixed always sends the one chosen below, Automatic lets AuraGo determine the category per request.
config.manifest.routing_specificity_help: Category that AuraGo sends with every request to Manifest in "Fixed" mode.
config.manifest.routing_headers_help: Custom headers as name and value pairs that AuraGo additionally sends to Manifest. Enter only values that Manifest may see.
